meta.title: A book’s trip through Ohio
meta.summary: The request and pickup are a shared-library workflow, with local account rules at either end.

sourceRefs.label: Columbus Metropolitan Library: SearchOhio & OhioLINK Catalogs

blocks.text: SearchOhio’s published steps begin in your library catalog: find an item, sign in with the details your library requests, and choose a pickup location. The network estimates three to five business days for requests, excluding weekends, and holds arrivals on the pickup shelf for ten days. Treat that as an estimate and wait for the arrival notice before traveling. After pickup, follow your account’s due date. Columbus Metropolitan Library publishes its own loan terms and return options; your own library sets the rules for your card. If the request option is missing, ask library staff about the item record.
